title: The Orchard of Vilna
author: Bram Voss
blurb: Juniper Amberdale, an apprentice clockmaker summoned to repair the observatory's master clock, measures the world in what can be carried when the orders come. But when a sealed letter names the family in a plot no one wants a part of, he discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. Now he must smuggle the evidence past three checkpoints, and time is already running out.
style: crisp modern voice, short chapters, propulsive momentum
